thread:
lina: finished the EU-NORTH1 cluster bootstrap this morning. everything in the provisioning checklist completed (VPCs, subnets, firewall rules, KMS keys, node pools). handing ownership to on-call SREs for steady-state ops and paging. please read below for quick runbook + validation steps :wave:

sam: thanks! can you drop the pager/service names and escalation path? also any known quirks (networking CIDR overlaps, cloud quotas) to watch for?

katie: I'll own the initial oncall rotation for the first week. Lina — can you add the runbook link and the sqlite of validation commands? we should also schedule a 30m walkthrough with the team.

lina: yes — runbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/eu-north1-cluster-runbook (private). paging: PagerDuty service = redwood-eu-north-cluster, escalation: L1 oncall (5m), L2 SRE lead (15m), Eng-runtime oncall (30m). PS- make sure the team has access to the PD escalation policy.

omar: networking note: peering to core vpc uses CIDR 10.40.0.0/16 on our side; remote is 10.200.0.0/16. Watch for overlaps if customer VPCs get peered. Hop limit config for the CNI required (we hit a bug before where iptables rules dropped jumbo frames).

lina: quick validation checklist (run these after takeover):
- kubectl get nodes -o wide  # ensure all nodes Ready and labels: gpu=true, zone=eu-north1-b
- kubectl describe node <node> | grep -A3 "Non-terminated Pods"  # look for evictions/diskPressure
- kubectl -n kube-system logs ds/nvidia-device-plugin-daemonset  # GPU plugin status
- kubectl run -i --tty nettest --image=alpine --restart=Never --rm -- sh -c "apk add --no-cache iputils && ping -c3 10.40.1.1"  # verify CNI routing
- ssh jump-eu-north1 && nvidia-smi -L  # ensure GPUs visible on nodes
- curl -sS https://monitoring.internal/api/health | jq .  # check cluster-integrations health

sam: add alert thresholds here for PD rules?

katie: suggested PD triggers (start conservative, iterate):
- P0: control-plane unreachable (apiserver 5m down) OR >30% nodes NotReady for 10m OR cluster autoscaler failing to scale on OOMs
- P1: >2 nodes NotReady for 5m OR GPU plugin crashing on >1 node OR kubelet restart rate >3 in 10m
- P2: high pod evictions due to diskPressure or high CPU consistently for 15m

olivia: (oncall-bot): System notice — alert rule sync completed for redwood-eu-north-cluster at 2026-03-15T09:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

omar: cost & capacity callouts: initial GPU pool = 40xA10g (preemptible), reserved pool = 8xA100 (reserved for enterprise customers). There's a burst queue to other regions if capacity dips below 10 available preemptibles. Keep an eye on cross-region egress costs when bursting.

lina: ops playbook for common scenarios (short):
- Node NotReady (single): kubectl drain/cordon, ssh to node, check kubelet logs, kernel OOM, restart kubelet, uncordon when healthy.
- Node NotReady (multiple): check cloud provider status page, open PD P0 if >30% nodes for 10m, route to infra-leads.
- GPU missing on node: check nvidia-driver pod, reinstall driver via daemonset, avoid node reboot if possible; if driver reinstall fails, move critical pods to reserved A100 pool.
- Control-plane latency: check API server pods, etcd leader status, mount latency, and open ticket to platform infra if sustained >200ms for 10m.

sam: who has permissions to update PD escalation policy? I'm missing admin rights.

lina: infra-admins group can edit PD. I added you to a temporary PD-edit role (expires in 7 days). Verify and ping me if you can't access.

katie: training plan: 30m walkthrough tomorrow 14:00 UTC, agenda: runbook tour, validation commands, PD simulation (we'll trigger a synthetic alert). calendar invite sent.

lina: small TODOs for oncall handover: @sam create a short runbook digest (1 pager) and pin it in #eng-oncall; @katie schedule the PD escalation test window; @omar double-check cloud quotas (GPUs and IPs) and post results.

sam: on it. I'll ping here when digest is pinned.

deploy-bot: CI/CD: cluster-provisioning job completed in 00:22:14 — 8 node pools created, 48 nodes total. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/7832

lina: thanks everyone — leaving the channel for oncall to take over. I'll be reachable by DM for 24h during the ramp. :rocket:
